source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 2 · lesson 14. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: The call to prayer, phrase by phrase

learn.en: Five times a day the mu'adh-dhin calls the adhan. It reminds Muslims that it is time to pray.
learn.title: The call to prayer

learn.en: When you hear the adhan, put aside what you are doing as soon as you can, and get ready for salah.
learn.title: Getting ready

learn.en: It begins: Allahu Akbar (×4); Ash-hadu an lā ilāha illa-llāh (×2); Ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan rasūlu-llāh (×2).
learn.title: The first part

learn.en: Then: Ḥayya ʿala ṣ-ṣalāh (×2) — hasten to prayer; Ḥayya ʿala l-falāḥ (×2) — hasten to success; Allahu Akbar (×2); Lā ilāha illa-llāh.
learn.title: The second part

learn.en: “When the adhan is called for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah, then proceed to the remembrance of Allah.” (Qur'an 62:9)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

words.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ
words.en: I testify that there is no god but Allah
I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah
There is no god but Allah

order.en: Put the phrases of the adhan in order

quiz.en: True or false? When you hear the adhan, you should get ready for salah.

think.q: When you hear the adhan, what will you stop doing to get ready for salah?
think.a: Pause the game or the screen, make wudu, and go to pray!

parents.summary: The adhan calls to prayer five times a day: Allāhu akbar, the two shahadas, ḥayya ʿala ṣ-ṣalāh, ḥayya ʿala l-falāḥ, Allāhu akbar, lā ilāha illa-llāh.
parents.tip: Let him call the adhan at home for one prayer.
